properties.name: page
properties.description: One-based page number. Leave it out to render a truncation item, the ellipsis that stands in for the pages between two page numbers.

design.name: ✏️ Page
design.note: The page number is the visible text of the item. In Figma the truncation is its own helper component (🛟 Pagination Truncation), not a value of this item, so the item always carries a page. In code there is no such component: DBPagination renders the truncation by leaving out the page and drawing an ellipsis on the bordering page.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name of the page, for example `Page 5 of 10`. The visible text is only a bare number, so the context lives in this label - it is not rendered.

design.name: ✏️ Label
design.note: Not rendered, it is the accessible name of the page. In code DBPagination derives it from pageLabel, whose default "Page {page} of {totalPages}" follows the same pattern; Figma spells the placeholders as X and Y.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Renders the page as an anchor instead of a button, which makes the pagination deep linkable and usable without JavaScript.

properties.name: layout
properties.description: Which layout the item belongs to. Defaults to `always`.

design.name: 🔀 Current
design.note: The Figma property is named Current, the code prop active (from the shared ActiveProps). It renders the current page and maps to aria-current="page". The default is False. Unlike the other two axes the values carry no (Def) marker on purpose: Figma only renders the axis as a toggle while the values are exactly True and False.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size attribute changes the font-size and other related sizes of the component.

design.note: No variant property in Figma. Medium and Small are modelled as separate component sets (Pagination Item - Medium, Pagination Item - Small), one per main component of the parent. The parent's Children slot suggests the matching set per size. The truncation is a separate helper component (🛟 Pagination Truncation) that ships in a Medium and a Small variant of its own.

design.name: 🔀 Interaction State
design.note: Figma-only. Documents the visual states of the item; in code these are the native interaction states of the underlying button or anchor and are not a property.
